jobs.job_description:
​​Batterjee Medical College is seeking an experienced ERP Consultant​ to lead the implementation, optimization, and continuous improvement of the Odoo ERP platform. This role is responsible for analyzing business requirements, configuring Odoo solutions, managing ERP projects, supporting end users, and collaborating with technical teams to deliver scalable, high-quality enterprise solutions that support academic and administrative operations.

Key Responsibilities

Business Analysis & Requirement Gathering

• Analyze business requirements and map them accurately to Odoo functionalities.

• Engage with key stakeholders to understand workflows, document processes, and identify system improvement opportunities.

• Translate business processes into functional specifications for technical teams.

• Create and maintain business process documentation and visual process maps.

System Configuration & Implementation

• Perform full system implementation, module setup, and advanced Odoo configurations.

• Test modules and functionalities, ensuring they meet defined requirements.

• Coordinate with Odoo developers to customize and enhance system performance.

• Support data migration, system validation, and go-live activities.

• Ensure quality assurance and user acceptance testing are completed successfully.

Project Management & Delivery

• Manage assigned Odoo projects and tasks, ensuring delivery within scope, time, and quality standards.

• Track project progress and maintain reporting documentation including project plans and task lists.

• Collaborate with the Enterprise Systems Director to prioritize system enhancements and upgrades.

• Contribute to research and advisory on new Odoo modules, apps, and verticals to meet institutional requirements.

User Training & Support

• Conduct end-user and departmental training on Odoo modules and best practices.

• Coach business users on how to utilize Odoo effectively and autonomously.

• Deliver training sessions on-site or remotely, ensuring adoption and understanding.

• Provide functional support and guidance post-implementation.

Quality & Continuous Improvement

• Enhance the quality and performance of Odoo products and services.

• Evaluate system performance and recommend optimization measures.

• Contribute to continuous improvement of business processes and IT systems.

• Stay current with Odoo updates, best practices, and community advancements.

Documentation & Reporting

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation of configurations, enhancements, and workflows.

• Prepare reports on Odoo performance, issues, and proposed improvements.

• Support audits and compliance reviews related to system operations.

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.

• Odoo Certification or formal Odoo training is an advantage.

Experience

• 8–15 years of experience in Odoo Functional Consulting or ERP implementation.

• Proven experience in business process analysis, solution design, and functional configuration.

• Experience implementing and supporting Odoo ERP across multiple business functions.

• Exposure to HR, Finance, Procurement, or Administrative modules is highly preferred.

Required Skills

• Strong expertise in Odoo ERP implementation, configuration, troubleshooting, and optimization.

• Solid understanding of ERP business processes and data management.

• Knowledge of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and project management methodologies.

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

• Ability to translate business requirements into functional specifications.

• Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

• Fluent in English (written and spoken); Arabic is an advantage.

Personal Competencies

• Integrity and professionalism

• Analytical thinking and problem-solving

• Communication and collaboration

• Planning and organizational skills

• Accountability and ownership

• Adaptability and flexibility

• Customer-focused mindset

• Innovation and continuous improvement

• Attention to detail

• Self-motivation and continuous learning

Job Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented and collaborative ERP Specialist (SAP) to join our IT and business operations team. The successful candidate will support, configure, and optimize our SAP landscape to enable business processes across finance, supply chain, manufacturing, and human resources. This role partners closely with cross-functional stakeholders including Finance, Procurement, Operations, and external implementation partners to deliver reliable, auditable, and user-friendly ERP solutions. Strong functional knowledge of SAP modules, pragmatic problem-solving, and clear communication are essential.

Key Responsibilities

SAP System Support & Configuration

• Provide day-to-day support for SAP modules (e.g., FI/CO, MM, SD, PP, HR) including incident resolution, root cause analysis, and corrective actions.
• Configure SAP master data, modules, workflows, authorization roles, and interfaces according to business requirements and best practices.
• Manage transport requests, system changes, and configuration documentation following established change control procedures.

Project Delivery & Enhancements

• Participate in ERP implementation, upgrade, and enhancement projects: gather requirements, perform fit/gap analysis, design solutions, and support testing and deployment activities.
• Collaborate with Product Owners and business SMEs to translate process requirements into SAP configuration, custom development requests, or process workarounds.
• Support user acceptance testing (UAT), create test scripts, and validate business scenarios to ensure high quality releases.

Integrations, Data & Reporting

• Coordinate with integration teams to maintain reliable interfaces between SAP and third-party systems, ensuring data consistency and timely processing.
• Perform data migrations and periodic data cleansing activities; develop and validate data extracts, transforms, and loads as required.
• Create and maintain operational and financial reports, queries, and dashboards to support business decision-making and regulatory requirements.

Governance, Security & Continuous Improvement

• Support SAP security administration including role design, segregation of duties analysis, and periodic access reviews to maintain compliance and least-privilege principles.
• Document solution designs, configuration settings, runbooks, and operational procedures to support knowledge transfer and audit readiness.
• Proactively identify opportunities to improve ERP processes, automation, and system performance; recommend and implement practical improvements.

Required Qualifications - Skills & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business, Finance, Supply Chain, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• 3+ years of hands-on experience supporting or configuring SAP (or comparable ERP systems) in a production environment.
• Practical knowledge of at least one SAP functional area (e.g., FI/CO, MM, SD, PP, HCM) and familiarity with core business processes.
• Experience with SAP configuration, transports, master data management, and basic ABAP awareness for troubleshooting integrations or custom reports.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Experience using ticketing systems, change control processes, and documenting technical and functional specifications.
• Effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to conduct user training and create clear process documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

• SAP certification in a relevant module (e.g., S/4HANA, FI/CO, MM, SD) or equivalent vendor certification.
• Experience with S/4HANA migrations, upgrades, or cloud-hosted SAP landscapes.
• Familiarity with integration tools and middleware (e.g., SAP PI/PO, CPI, IDoc, APIs) and experience implementing interfaces between ERP and other enterprise systems.
• Knowledge of segregation of duties tools, audit controls, and experience supporting compliance and internal audit requests.
• Experience with reporting tools and BI platforms (e.g., SAP BW/4HANA, SAP Analytics Cloud, Power BI) is a plus.
• Experience working in cross-functional teams and mentoring junior ERP or business analysts.

Work Environment & Compensation

• Full-time position with a hybrid onsite/remote work model; occasional travel for system rollouts, vendor meetings, or team offsites may be required.
• Competitive salary commensurate with experience and a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, retirement plan options, and paid time off.
• Opportunities for professional development, training support, and career growth within IT and business operations functions.
• Inclusive and respectful workplace culture that values diversity, equity, and work-life balance.

About the Client

Dammam, Saudi Arabia

to support its digital transformation initiatives and optimize Oracle Fusion ERP solutions across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

• Analyze business requirements and translate them into Oracle Fusion solutions.

• Configure and optimize Oracle Fusion ERP modules.

• Collaborate with business stakeholders to improve operational processes.

• Support system integration, testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), and go-live activities.

• Provide user training, knowledge transfer, and post-go-live support.

• Troubleshoot system issues and recommend continuous improvements.

• Proven hands-on experience with
Oracle Fusion ERP

Resemble Systems is looking for a dynamic and result-oriented ERP Software Sales Consultant based in Riyadh to support our business growth in Saudi Arabia.

We specialize in Business Process Automation, Odoo ERP Solutions, IBM Enterprise Software Solutions, and Digital Transformation services for companies across Saudi Arabia and the UAE.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in ERP software sales, lead generation, client meetings, proposal preparation, and closing deals. Preference will be given to candidates with prior Odoo ERP sales experience and existing relationships with decision makers in Saudi Arabia.

This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious sales professional who wants to grow with a fast-growing technology and strategy consulting company.

Duties & Responsibilities

• Generate new business opportunities and qualified leads in Saudi Arabia
• Identify customer pain points and position ERP solutions accordingly
• Conduct client meetings, product presentations, and demonstrations
• Prepare proposals, quotations, and follow-up with prospects
• Work closely with the technical and functional consulting teams
• Build strong relationships with CIOs, IT Managers, Finance Managers, and Business Owners
• Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets
• Maintain CRM pipeline and sales activities professionally
• Coordinate with management on sales strategy and market opportunities

Required Experience & Skills

• Minimum 2–5 years experience in ERP software sales
• Experience selling Odoo ERP solutions is highly preferred
• Understanding of business processes such as Finance, Inventory, HR, CRM, Procurement, and Manufacturing
• Strong communication and negotiation skills
• Experience in B2B sales within Saudi Arabia market preferred
• Arabic speaking is an added advantage
• Self-motivated, target-driven, and professional attitude
• Valid Saudi driving license preferred

What We Offer

• Attractive salary + commission structure
• Career growth opportunity
• Exposure to enterprise clients and digital transformation projects
• Professional and supportive work environment
